events.title: 灯下拾页
events.scene: A single antique paper lantern with no oil, burning with a small pale ghost flame under a dark corridor eave; several blank manuscript pages lift in the wind, one page catching a muted cinnabar edge, an ink-stone floor and one carved wooden bracket.

events.title: 井中回声
events.scene: A deep old stone well in a forgotten garden, wet darkness inside, pale concentric ripples climbing the inner wall; a frayed rope, crooked wooden bucket, wet stone slabs, sparse fern and a faint cold ghost-light deep below.

events.title: 础石留字
events.scene: A heavy old stone column base half buried in a grassy path, one deep abstract chisel scar on its surface, no readable inscription; fallen roof tiles, moss, a broken wooden pillar and a tiny cinnabar paper offering.

events.title: 借寿
events.scene: A closed garden gate at night, one hanging paper lantern, a low stone table with a blank folded paper contract and a small ink seal; a thin human-shaped shadow lengthens away from the lamp with no face or visible body.

events.title: 讨债
events.scene: A weathered courtyard gate with a thin folded ledger and a blank debt slip tucked under the door, a small dark seal stone beside it; a long shadow of an unseen visitor crosses the threshold, cold blue-teal night and one restrained cinnabar seal accent.

events.title: 苔阶残局
events.scene: Old moss-covered stone steps in a garden, a half-finished chess-like arrangement made from small blank wooden movable-type blocks; one final tile rests off the board, a fallen leaf and a faint ghost-light in shallow fog.

events.title: 雨打空廊
events.scene: An empty covered garden corridor in cold rain, a bundle of wet blank pages on the floor, thin streams of water crossing the stone, a single fallen copper coin nearby; dark teal wood, wet grey stone and one tiny cinnabar thread on the binding.

events.title: 松根埋字
events.scene: Twisted roots of an old pine lifting the soil, two blank wooden movable-type blocks partly buried beneath them, a burnt incense root, a few pale mushrooms, deep forest shadow and moss.

events.title: 池边钓叟
events.scene: A still dark pond with an abandoned fishing rod, a woven creel and an empty low stool on the bank; a floating bobber makes one small ring, a faint pale reflection under the water suggests a distant listener, but no person.

events.title: 石桌残谱
events.scene: A weathered stone table under a garden tree, an open blank musical score held down by a smooth pebble, scattered dry leaves and one small glowing blank wooden type block; quiet autumnal shadows, dark teal stone and a restrained cinnabar leaf.

events.title: 纸鸢挂树
events.scene: A torn paper kite caught high in an old pine, its red string wrapped around a branch and a small blank wooden tag hanging below; wind-bent needles and a distant misty garden roof.

events.title: 老园丁
events.scene: A quiet pond-side pruning scene with heavy iron shears resting on a cut branch, a clay tea bowl, a folded gardener's cloth and a small pile of twigs; no person, dark teal foliage, old-gold tool fittings and one cinnabar leaf.

events.title: 旧砚生苔
events.scene: An abandoned stone inkstone half filled with rain, green moss creeping around the ink pool, a dark glossy ink surface reflecting a narrow closed-eye-shaped highlight; a worn brush and a blank scrap of paper beside it.

events.title: 渡口无舟
events.scene: An empty ferry dock in blood-yellow mist, a broken mooring rope on a wooden post, no boat, a distant blank stone stele across the water; dark reed silhouettes, still ripples and one muted cinnabar knot on the rope.

events.title: 无主字匣
events.scene: A wooden movable-type case with a rusted lock, slightly open and filled with blank square type blocks; loose blank paper slips and a thin layer of dust on a dark corridor floor, a faint ghost-light leaking from the gap.

events.title: 破碑拓工
events.scene: A broken stele with a sheet of blank rubbing paper pressed over its surface, a rubbing brush and ink pad on the ground, one extra strip of paper curling loose; no person, only the tools and recent presence.

events.title: 墨池浮灯
events.scene: A single small paper lantern floating on a still black ink pond, warm cinnabar paper reflected in the water, a half-burnt blank wooden type block beneath the surface, dark garden stones, thin reeds and a few pale ghost sparks.

events.title: 夜半敲门
events.scene: A closed old garden door at night, a folded triangular paper talisman and one damp blank letter pushed under the gap, a small lantern hanging beside the latch; a long narrow shadow on the doorstep, no visible person or face.

events.title: 碑后小龛
events.scene: A small stone niche hidden behind a broken stele, containing one dull brass coin, a half-burnt incense stick and a thin blank ledger; ash, moss, a tiny cinnabar thread and a cold shaft of light.

events.title: 韫椟待贾
events.scene: An old wooden presentation box suspended by a rope in a dusty storehouse, its lid slightly open and a soft jade-green light escaping; a blank paper price tag, dark shelves and one cinnabar cord.

events.title: 买椟还珠
events.scene: An ornate lacquered Chinese box on a worn market table, inlaid with mother-of-pearl and a tiny muted cinnabar jewel, its lid open to reveal an empty silk lining; a few blank paper wrappers and a dark awning overhead, no people.

events.title: 怀璧其罪
events.scene: A solitary jade disc with a dark blood-red stain resting on a small abandoned shrine altar, wrapped in a torn dark cloth; broken incense sticks, a blank stone tablet and cold garden shadows.

events.title: 齐人攫金
events.scene: An empty gold-lacquered box on a street market stall, its lid open and lining bare, one fallen coin on the ground; blank price slips, a toppled stool and watching shadows at the edge, no people.

events.title: 被中香炉
events.scene: A small antique bronze bed censer with a pierced lid, resting inside an open old wooden chest on a folded quilt; a thin curl of warm incense, a blank paper label and a soft old-gold highlight.

events.title: 裁字
events.scene: A thin calligraphy knife resting on a sheet of blank cut paper, several tiny blank paper squares falling from the page, an open empty type case and a dim corridor desk; one restrained cinnabar thread on the knife handle.

events.title: 删诗
events.scene: An abandoned old academy room with stacks of blank scrolls, a shallow ash pit and one half-burnt page curling at the edge; a dark wooden desk, a single cinnabar seal and drifting ash.

events.title: 还笔
events.scene: A five-coloured writing brush lying across a folded quilt at the foot of an old bed, its tip dark with ink, a thin dreamlike wisp of pale blue ghost light above it; a blank paper page and a shadowed garden window.

events.title: 浣墨
events.scene: A dark garden ink pool with pale clean ripples spreading from a submerged blank wooden type block, a folded white cloth on the stone rim and a few drops of black ink; one tiny cinnabar leaf floating.

events.title: 涤除
events.scene: A shallow stone bowl filled with perfectly still water acting as a mirror, a blank white cloth beside it and a small empty bronze cup; dark garden stones, pale reflected light and one faint circular ripple.

events.title: 璇玑拾字
events.scene: An unfinished woven brocade hanging from a dark garden loom, its square grid woven from blank pale and cinnabar threads, a few loose silk threads curling down; subtle old-gold loom fittings and a quiet ink pond below.

events.title: 乱文骨骰
events.scene: A single old bone die on a dark stone garden table, every face blank, surrounded by a few scattered blank wooden type blocks and a thin curl of ghost smoke; deep blue-teal shadows and one restrained cinnabar edge.

events.title: 死地取器
events.scene: A suit of dark lamellar armour standing empty beside a planted sword, an old relic box at its feet, a torn banner and a few scattered blank type blocks; no body or face, cold pale ghost-light and one cinnabar cord.

events.title: 射覆
events.scene: Three inverted ceramic bowls on a weathered stone table in a dark garden, one thin wisp of pale ghost fire curling between them; a few fallen leaves and a small blank wooden tally, no people.
